name: Subsurface Scattering Approximation via Local Thickness
definition: Approximates subsurface scattering by computing the local thickness of a surface along random inward hemispherical directions, then using the thickness to modulate a simplified SSS lighting term.
summary: Subsurface Scattering Approximation via Local Thickness estimates translucency by probing random inward directions to compute per-pixel thickness, differing from volumetric methods by avoiding global acceleration or integration.
